channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Bukit Kayu Hitam MCBA commander returns to social media after shooting incident
item.description: KOTA BARU: Two weeks after he was nearly killed in a shooting, Bukit Kayu Hitam Malaysian Border Control and Protection Agency (MCBA) commander has resumed activity on social media.

item.title: Thai national killed, three injured in express bus-4WD collision
item.description: KUANTAN: A Thai national was killed and three others were injured in a four-wheel-drive and express bus collision at Km14 of Jalan Pekan–Kuantan here early this morning.

item.title: Animal cruelty must be met with firm justice
item.description: LETTERS: The Sunday Times report today revealing that 6,423 animal welfare complaints were investigated over the past five years, with more than 80 per cent involving neglect, was deeply troubling.

item.title: Piastri takes blame for crashing out before home Australian Grand Prix
item.description: MELBOURNE: Shattered home hope Oscar Piastri took responsibility for a crash on his way to the grid that ruled him out of Sunday’s Australian Grand Prix, saying he was “very disappointed.”

item.title: MAKAF won't get sentimental in selection
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Karate Association of Malaysia (MAKAF) has made clear that reputation alone will not be enough to get selected for the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games from Sept 19-Oct 4.

item.title: China will remain most stable engine of global economy
item.description: BEIJING: China will remain the most stable engine of the global economy, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Sunday, reported Xinhua.

item.title: Over RM60,000 worth of unregistered cosmetic products seized in Johor raid
item.description: JOHOR BARU: Johor Health Department seized more than RM60,000 worth of unregistered and unnotified health and cosmetic products during a coordinated raid targeting illegal aesthetic services on Tuesday (March 3).

item.title: Motorists give cars festive makeover ahead of Raya journeys
item.description: JOHOR BARU: As households prepared for Hari Raya Aidilfitri with new curtains, a fresh coat of paint and upgraded appliances, another festive trend quietly gathered pace.

item.title: The price we pay for avoiding difficult conversations
item.description: THIS is an essay of hope and disappointment, but mostly disappointment, about a country I want to love, but have come to experience as increasingly repressive.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Lisa's sweet zoo outing: Blackpink star meets viral Japanese macaque Punch
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Global K-pop sensation Lisa has once again sent social media into a frenzy, this time by sharing a touching encounter during her visit to a special resident of Japan.
